comps.name: Defender Diana Reroll — Defender Emblem
comps.source: your game, 2026-10-18 (1st place); positions from Kha'Zix Reroll
augments: Silver: Team Building, Latent Forge, Rolling For Days
Prismatic: Deadlier Caps, Buried Treasures III
comps.notes: Key comp this meta: Kha'Zix reaches the backline and kills the one carry that 1-cost 2★ rageblade boards depend on. Diana, Kha'Zix and Fiddlesticks 3★. Only works with the Defender Emblem on Diana: take it from carousel / armory / an emblem augment. Without it, play Kha'Zix Reroll.

plan.when: Level to 7 around 3-5 / 4-1, then slow roll the gold above 50. If you have to roll early to stabilise, roll at 6 for the 2-cost pieces only — then rebuild gold and get to 7 before rolling for 3-costs (3-cost odds at 6 are only 25%).
plan.bail: Switch if 2+ opponents hold your carry, or you're under ~30 HP at 4-1 without a 2★ carry.
plan.realistic: Realistic target: Diana, Kha'Zix and Fiddlesticks 3★ at level 7-8, Diana with the Defender Emblem; Hecarim full tank items.

comps.name: Nidalee Flex (yours) — Standard
comps.source: your 1st place, Normal, 2026-10-21 (40:49, out to 7-1): board and items from tactics.tools, 3★ from your end screen. Positions are a guess (tanks front, Nidalee melee, ranged carries back). Opener and stage advice from TFT Academy's Aphelios Nidalee and bunnymuffins' Aphelios Flex.
augments: Best (your win): Commerce Core, Trade Sector, Trade Sector+ (free rerolls), Explosive Growth, Explosive Growth+ (XP to 8), Birthday Reunion
comps.notes: Your comeback: 19 HP at 4-7, then no HP lost for 14 rounds to 1st. 3★ Nidalee one-shots the backline (Shojin, Striker's, Edge of Night), 3★ Diana and Varus, Aphelios as the second carry (Guinsoo's, Deathblade, Kraken's), Amumu and Sentinel tank. SeeMeta had Lunar Nidalee at 57.7% top 4 on 18.4. Your game's early board was different: Varus, Ornn, Rakan, Yorick, Rammus (stage 2), Diana and Kog'Maw from 4-1; Nidalee and Aphelios only came at level 8 (5-1). It was touch and go: 91 HP at 3-1 down to 19 by 4-7 while you transitioned, so play the strongest board you have until 8 and save HP for the switch.

plan.when: Econ to 50 and level 8 around 4-1 / 4-2, then roll down for the 4-cost carries. Upgrade to 5-costs at 9 if you're healthy.
plan.bail: Switch if you can't find the carries by your roll-down, or the lobby is heavily contested.
plan.realistic: Realistic target: 2★ 4-cost carries with full items at level 8. 5-costs and 3★ 4-costs are upside.

howto.gameplan: Same final board as TFT Academy's A-tier Aphelios Nidalee. Win-streak with an AD / attack speed opener (Akali holding the items), then level 8 and roll for the 4-costs. Aphelios is the gameplan when you have a good AD opener but can't quite bridge the gap to level 9 and play for Draven. He is a great AD default and uses most items decently. Nidalee is the best duo carry but Brambleback can work, specially if you have a Rapidfire Emblem.
stages: Stage 1-2
Play a strong opener around any AD or Attack Speed slam. Guinsoo's isn't BIS but it is strong early game and more than serviceable.
Stage 3

Continue to be strong around an AD holder with Aphelios or Nidalee items. If you are heavily loss streaking prepare to roll down on 4-1 to try to hit Sentinel and Nidalee before the rest of the lobby.
Stage 4

Roll down for Aphelios, Sentinel and Nidalee. Flex the front line if the lobby is heavily contesting Sentinel. Nidalee can stabilize bad spots extremely well so prioritize her itemization if you are playing from low HP.
Stage 5+
Don't level to 9 until you've 2 starred Aphelios and Brambleback. Go 9 for Alune or a Lux.
tips: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.
Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
items: Spear of Shojin, Striker's Flail, Edge of Night

comps.name: Vanguard Morgana (sleeper) — Standard
comps.source: SeeMeta ranked results 7–21 Oct 2026 ('Vanguard Morgana' 61.6% top 4, avg 3.76), reshaped from your Tocker's test (2026-10-24). Items from the guides (Morgana: bunnymuffins' Invoker Ahri card; Sentinel: Vow + Adaptive). Positions are a guess.
comps.notes: Sleeper: SeeMeta's 'Vanguard Morgana' had the second-best ranked numbers (61.6% top 4) and no guide covers it. Your Tocker's test: the 2★ 5-costs (Taric, Elder Dragon) are too hard to hit and games barely reach 8 against Solar / Elderwood / Fae / Riftbeast mid-game boards, so this is the level 8 version: Fiddlesticks 3★ tanks (Sunfire for the anti-heal on Fae / Elise), Hecarim makes Vanguard 4 instead of Taric, Morgana carries, Alune is the upside. Late, if healthy: Taric for Hecarim, Elder Dragon (2 slots) at 10.

plan.when: Slow roll at level 7 (3-5 / 4-1) for Fiddlesticks 3★ and 2★ Diana / Elise / Hecarim, then level 8 at 4-2 and roll for Morgana and Sentinel 2★. Games rarely reach 9 now: don't plan around 5-costs.
plan.bail: Switch if Fiddlesticks or Morgana is held by 2+ players, or you're under ~30 HP at 4-2 without a 2★ Morgana.
plan.realistic: Realistic target: Fiddlesticks 3★, Morgana and Sentinel 2★, at level 8. Alune 2★ is the upside; Taric and Elder Dragon only if the game goes long.

comps.name: Kog'Maw Adaptor 4 (yours) — Gromp
comps.source: bunnymuffins' Adaptor Master Yi Reroll (AP Adaptors) board and items + Gromp at level 8 for Adaptor 4 — your call after 612k Legendary in Tocker's (2026-10-24). Akali works as the 4th Adaptor too.
augments: Silver: Team Building, Latent Forge, Expedition
Gold: Portable Forge, Cooking Pot, Legion Of Threes
Prismatic: Forged In Strength, Sweet Treats, Living Forge
comps.notes: Only two 3★ chases: Kog'Maw (the carry) and Master Yi; Vi and Krug stay 2★ (Krug keeps Brawler 2 with Sett; a 2★ only needs 3 copies even with Riftbeast players around) — four 3★ 3-costs was too many for the shop. Get Gromp early: in stage 2 he and Akali already make Adaptor 2, and it saved you about 5 minutes of game time. Kog'Maw is the carry (Shojin, IE, Red Buff); Master Yi and Nidalee are the other Adaptors. Adaptor 4 (Master Yi, Kog'Maw, Nidalee + Gromp) at level 8: the 7-unit bunnymuffins board plus a 4th Adaptor, which is great for Yi. Gromp (2-cost, AP, ranged) is the easy pick; Akali (1-cost) also counts. Barely anyone plays these units, so the 3★ Yi / Kog'Maw / Vi / Krug come easily. Pivot: Aphelios (Nidalee Flex / Aphelios Nidalee) shares Nidalee, Kog'Maw and Vi, so hold an early Aphelios or two and go whichever way the 3★s come — Kog'Maw 3★, or Aphelios if he shows up more.

howto.gameplan: Play around a Yi, Rengar orb or a 2-1 artifact to get into this line. Master Yi is a stat stick that needs to either hit before tempo or have a special item to perform. Rengar is a great duo carry that can accelerate your econ but is very item specific and inconsistent to play for from behind. Non-Rengar Yi is AP, Yi Rengar is AD.
stages: Stage 1-2
Play your strongest board around an early Yi or Rengar and 3 Blossom or an Artifact holder. Do not hard commit to this line unless you have an Artifact, uncontested Rengar line or Bruiser Emblem.
Stage 3
If by 3-2 the Yi set up looks inconsistent look to pivot to a 4 cost line. If you have a strong stage 3 Yi or Rengar set up use the tempo to econ up to roll for Yi 3 on stage 4.
Stage 4
Slow roll for Yi, Kog'Maw, Rengar and a 3 star front liner. If you don't have a special item you will likely struggle against upgraded 4 cost boards unless you can cheat out a 3 star ahead of tempo.
Stage 5+
Complete your 3 stars and push for more Adaptor trait levels. If you reach 3 item Yi, Kog'Maw, Tank and Rengar you are in a great spot to top 2.
tips: Nidalee 2 is a enough to cover backline damage if you miss on Kog'Maw 3 but Yi 3 is absolutely non-negotiable.
This comp doesn't do great from behind so make sure you have a very good condition if you are playing it from loss streak.

Take the Healing Primal buff most of your games. If you are >50 HP, strong and have a consistent way for Nidalee to get takedowns, you can consider taking items. Primal Buff Prio: Healing > Attack Speed > Execute
items: Master Yi*: Guinsoo's*, Edge of Night*, Titan's (Special Item Priority: Wit's End > Hellfire Hatchet > Flickerblade > Fishbones > RFC > Brawler Emblem > Titanic Everything replaces Titan's except for Flicker which replaces Guinsoo's)
QSS*, Edge of Night*, Titan's (Special Item Priority: Hellfire Hatchet > Fishbones > RFC > Brawler Emblem > Titanic)

plan.realistic: Realistic target: main carry 3★, the rest 2★, at level 7 with full items. If the carry is still 2★ by 4-5, stop rolling — level and play for top 4. A 3★ board is the upside, not the plan.

comps.name: Tocker's Kog'Maw Adaptor (score)
comps.source: Your Kog'Maw Adaptor 4 (yours) — Gromp board and items, played for Tocker's Trials score: your best run was 612k Legendary with six 3★ at Lv 8 (2026-10-24). Rules from Riot's Tocker's Trials article (30 rounds, 3 lives; score = surviving champions, unused items, fight time, star-ups).
augments: Gold (1-5, 2-5): Portable Forge, Cooking Pot, Legion Of Threes
Prismatic (3-5): Forged In Strength, Sweet Treats, Living Forge
comps.notes: Tocker's Trials only (suggested there, or pin it). Same board and items as your Kog'Maw Adaptor 4, but six 3★ targets instead of two: nobody else takes copies (18 of each 3-cost, all yours) and every star-up adds to the score. Order: Kog'Maw, Master Yi, then Krug and Vi; Yorick and Gromp 3★ come almost free on the way. Nidalee and Sett stay 2★ (4-costs). Letters here = your Tocker's scores, not ranked results: 612k (2026-10-24) puts it at A behind Solar Kayle & Xayah's 692k (2026-10-25) and ahead of Spellweaver LeBlanc's 515k.

howto.gameplan: Score (game files) = Surviving Champs + Time Bonus + Star Levels + Gold Interest + Item Greed + Close Calls; the point values aren't in the files. So win fast and keep everyone alive: a frontline that holds and as many 3★ as you can fit. Your best: six 3★ at Lv 8, 612k Legendary.
stages: Stage 1

Passive XP gets you to Lv 5 by 2-1, so don't buy XP. Buy every Kog'Maw, Master Yi, Krug and Vi (all 18 copies are yours) and play Gromp, Akali, Yorick, Krug and Kog'Maw for Adaptor 2 and quick wins. Build to 50 gold. Augment at 1-5: items or reroll.
Stage 2
Lv 6 at 2-3, Lv 7 at 2-6. From Lv 7 roll everything above 50 for Kog'Maw 3★, then Master Yi. Slam Kog'Maw's and Yi's items as soon as they're done: faster fights score more. Augment at 2-5.
Stage 3

Finish Krug and Vi 3★ at Lv 7, then Lv 8 around 3-6 for Nidalee, Sett and Gromp (Adaptor 4). Prismatic augment at 3-5. Keep 50 gold for interest (Gold Interest scores every round) and roll only the gold above it; spend everything on the last round, 3-10.
tips: Get Gromp early: in your runs it cut about 5 minutes, and faster fights score more.
Three lives, not HP: three lost rounds ends the run. After a loss, roll for upgrades before the next fight.

Item Greed is one of the score bonuses in the game files (it pops up as 'Item Greed +X' after a round), but spare components on your bench didn't seem to trigger it. Watch which rounds show that popup to see what it counts, e.g. unopened anvils.

howto.gameplan: METAsrc's Elderwood Flora Fatalis (S) Tocker's comp. Score counts surviving champions, fight speed, star levels, gold interest, item greed and close calls, so win fast, keep everyone alive and keep 50 gold. Lives, not HP: three lost rounds end the run.
stages: Stage 1

Passive XP gets you to Lv 5 by 2-1. Buy every Xayah, Ornn, Alistar and LeBlanc and roll the gold above 50 at Lv 5 for Xayah and Ornn 3★. Have 3 Elderwood on the board by 1-9 for the Stonebark Tree and Lifebloom. 1-9 is 14 ranged archers, and their arrows weaken with every body they pass through, so put the trees in front. Stage 1 is the only place this build has lost lives.
Stage 2

Keep items on the bench until 2-5 (that enemy is too hard without them), then tank items first, then Ezreal and Xayah. Lv 6 at 2-3 (LeBlanc, Alistar 3★), Lv 7 at 2-6 for Hecarim (Vow, Crownguard, Warmog's) and Fiddlesticks. Roll down at Lv 8 on 2-10 for Ezreal (Last Whisper, Shojin, Deathblade) and Soraka (Adaptive Helm, Nashor's, Rabadon's).
Stage 3

Lv 9 around 3-5 for Gnar: 7 Elderwood. Keep 50 gold for interest (Gold Interest scores every round); spend everything on the last round, 3-10. The 3-10 boss is one huge dragon: make sure Ezreal has Last Whisper, which cuts armor. Xayah's feathers and Gnar cut armor too.
tips: Three lives instead of 100 HP: each lost round costs one and three ends the run. After a loss, roll for upgrades before the next fight.

Item Greed is one of the score bonuses in the game files (it pops up as 'Item Greed +X' after a round), but spare components on your bench didn't seem to trigger it. Watch which rounds show that popup to see what it counts, e.g. unopened anvils.
items: Last Whisper, Spear of Shojin, Deathblade
Adaptive Helm, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap

howto.gameplan: Tocker's copy of bunnymuffins' Aphelios Flex: same board and items, Tocker's leveling and stages. Aphelios is the gameplan when you have a good AD opener but can't quite bridge the gap to level 9 and play for Draven. He is a great AD default and uses most items decently. Nidalee is the best duo carry but Brambleback can work, specially if you have a Rapidfire Emblem.
stages: Stage 1

Passive XP gets you to Lv 5 by 2-1. Play a strong opener around attack damage and attack speed units, but keep the items on the bench until 2-5 (Item Greed): the guide's early Guinsoo's slam is for lobbies. 1-9 is 14 ranged archers: field as many units as you can.
Stage 2

Lv 6 at 2-3, Lv 7 at 2-6. 2-2 (Rammus) and 2-4 (Elise) have to be won without items. At 2-5 items go on: tank items first on Sentinel or Amumu (Vow, Crownguard, Gargoyle's, Warmog's), Aphelios's (Infinity Edge, Kraken's Fury, Red Buff) on him, or on an attack-damage holder until he arrives (the guide's holders: Xayah, Camille). Roll down at Lv 8 on 2-10 for Aphelios, Sentinel and Nidalee 2★.
Stage 3

3★ Aphelios and Nidalee at Lv 8–9 (the pool is all yours); Nidalee needs Spear of Shojin. Lv 9 around 3-5 for Alune or Lux. The 3-10 boss is one huge target: Aphelios and Nidalee's items carry it. Spend all your gold on 3-10.
tips: Three lives instead of 100 HP: each lost round costs one. After a loss, roll for upgrades before the next fight.
Item Greed: every item on your bench scores 2,500 a round. The KEEP / EQUIP line shows which to put on.
If you fully miss on Sentinel, Amumu + Juggernauts can hold the front line down. The goal is to have enough stall to protect Nidalee as she resets.
Guinsoo's on Aphelios is not BIS, Red Buff is. However, Guinsoo's is more than acceptable and should be slammed for tempo in stage 2. His itemization is very flexible as long as he has
The Nidalee variant has the added advantage of not needing sunder due to Kog'Maw's passive.
Nidalee has a lot of scam potential if you position her towards the enemy weakside. If you can get both Aphelios and Nidalee on a weak front liner on stage 4 you can win fights for free.
Nidalee and Brambleback are both very dependent on their core items. Nidalee needs Shojin while Brambleback needs at least 2 defensive items.
If you have Rapidfire Emblem play 5 Rapidfire instead with the emblem on Brambleback. Position on weakside to get as many resets on Brambleback as possible.
Amumu takes pure tank items, Sentinel likes mana tank items like Vow.
